name: code-explore
description: 数据驱动的大型源码导航站与同源 TeX/PDF 报告

scripts.build: npm run data:validate && npm run build:app && node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:i18n && npm run test:packages && npm run test:browser
scripts.verify: npm run data:generate && npm run report:all && npm run build && npm run test:browser && node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/verify_report.py --all && node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/audit_delivery.py
scripts.build:app: npm run typecheck && npm run catalog && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && vite build
